''See also: [[Akura Mercy Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Mercy]] is a highly gifted member of the [[Akura clan]] and the favored daughter of the [[Monarch]] [[Akura Malice]]. Recognized as a genius even by her family's high standards, her innate bloodline strength is so immense that it requires suppression to avoid overwhelming her [[spirit]]. She possesses various combat abilities, including proficiency with striker techniques, the use of [[bloodline armor]], and a [[Dream of Darkness]] [[technique]]. In battle, she utilizes a Black dragons{{!}}black dragon-staff and the Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker{{!}}Silent King Bow, often mixing techniques into her arrows to make them difficult for enemies to analyze. Characterized by a joyful and bright demeanor, [[Mercy]] often appears more like a friendly commoner than a member of a powerful clan. Despite her cheerful nature, she carries the heavy burden of leadership for her family and has worked to assist in guiding the clan. She is known to carry a vast supply of medicinal [[elixirs]] and sacred herbs to aid others. Throughout her journey, she has navigated complex family dynamics involving figures such as [[Akura Charity]] and [[Akura Fury]], while striving to maintain her own identity separate from the perceived cruelty of her mother.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Mercy]] is a slender young lady with vivid, shimmering purple eyes. She has been seen wearing broken green armor and carries a long black ponytail.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Regarded as a genius within the [[Akura clan]], she is the favored daughter and heir of [[Akura Malice]]. She demonstrates selflessness by practicing [[sacred arts]] for the benefit of others and sacrificing a bet to ensure the safety of her companions.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Mercy]] is the daughter of [[Akura Malice]], who named her as an heir and made a bet regarding her survival. She serves on a [[Skysworn squad]] alongside [[Lindon]], whom she protected at the cost of her bet, and [[Yerin]]. Additionally, she is addressed by [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias Arelius]], targeted by [[Seishen Daji]], and sought out by [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Truegold]] trainee, she possesses exceptional [[madra]] control, [[technique]] proficiency, and [[shadow aura]] compatibility. She is a record-setting combatant using bows, staffs, flying swords, and puppet [[constructs]], and she utilizes arrows with techniques that burn both flesh and soul.}}
